"Build an AI-powered internship matching system for South African students addressing the 46.1% youth unemployment crisis. Match students with opportunities based on: skills/qualifications, home province and transport accessibility (taxi routes/car ownership), NSFAS recipient status (stipend availability critical), language proficiency, willingness to relocate, and career goals. Prioritize matches for students from disadvantaged backgrounds when companies indicate diversity commitments. Provide match confidence scores (0-100%) with clear explanations: why this match works, considering SA-specific factors like industry growth sectors, township/rural accessibility, and inclusive company culture. Interface must be mobile-first, data-light, work offline for top matches, and support multi-language explanations (starting with English, isiZulu, Afrikaans)."

"Using Lovable.dev, create an AI smart matching system with Gemini 2.5 Pro for complex matching logic. Build React components for: (1) Student profile wizard collecting skills, location, transport, NSFAS status, language, career goals; (2) Internship database with company details, accessibility, stipend info, language requirements; (3) Matching algorithm using vector embeddings weighing: skills (40%), location/transport (25%), cultural fit (20%), financial viability (10%), growth potential (5%); (4) Results page showing matches with confidence scores and explanations; (5) Offline caching using service workers for top 10 matches. Use Lovable Cloud for hosting and real-time sync. Optimize for mobile-first with minimal data usage."

UI Design: "Create mobile-first profile wizard with progress bar, 5 steps: Basic Info, Skills & Education, Location & Transport, Preferences, Review. Use large touch targets, save progress after each step for offline resilience. Include icons for visual guidance. Implement in React with Tailwind CSS."

Backend Integration: "Set up Lovable AI with Gemini 2.5 Pro API for matching logic. Create vector embeddings for student profiles and opportunities using text-embedding-004 model. Build matching function calculating cosine similarity + weighted scoring. Store in Lovable Cloud database with real-time sync."

Testing: "Test matching algorithm with 50 diverse student profiles (urban/township/rural, various skills, different provinces). Validate: (1) accuracy of matches, (2) explanation clarity, (3) bias detection (equal opportunity for disadvantaged students), (4) offline functionality, (5) mobile performance. A/B test with real users."

Deployment: "Deploy to Lovable Cloud with CDN for SA users. Configure service workers for offline caching of top matches. Set up analytics tracking: match view rate, apply rate, success rate by province/background. Enable feature flags for gradual rollout."

Optimization: "Optimize for low bandwidth: compress images to WebP, lazy load match cards, preload critical assets. Implement virtual scrolling for match lists. Add performance monitoring with Core Web Vitals tracking specific to SA network conditions."

"Using Firebase Studio, build scalable AI matching system leveraging Google Cloud infrastructure. Implement: (1) Firestore for student/opportunity data with real-time sync, (2) Cloud Functions for matching algorithm with Vertex AI, (3) Authentication with Firebase Auth supporting phone number login (common in SA), (4) Cloud Storage for profile documents, (5) Firebase ML for on-device matching predictions. Use Crashlytics and Performance Monitoring optimized for SA network conditions. Deploy with Firebase Hosting + CDN."

UI Design: "Create Flutter/React web app with Firebase UI library. Design profile collection forms with real-time validation. Build match results cards with Material Design 3, optimized for mobile. Implement dark mode (battery saving for students). Add offline support with Firebase Offline Persistence."

Backend Integration: "Set up Firestore collections: students, opportunities, matches. Create Cloud Function 'calculateMatches' triggered on profile updates, using Vertex AI Matching Engine. Implement security rules for POPI compliance. Configure Firebase ML Kit for on-device preliminary matching (works offline)."

Testing: "Use Firebase Test Lab to test on actual SA Android devices (Samsung A series, Huawei). Validate: database queries performance, Cloud Functions response time, offline sync reliability. Load test with 10,000 concurrent users simulating SA peak hours (18:00-21:00)."

Deployment: "Deploy with Firebase Hosting to Johannesburg region (closest to SA users). Configure Cloud CDN for static assets. Set up Firebase Performance Monitoring with custom traces for matching algorithm. Enable Firebase Analytics tracking user journey from profile to application."

Optimization: "Implement Firestore query optimization: composite indexes for complex filters, pagination for large result sets. Use Firebase Dynamic Links for WhatsApp sharing of opportunities. Configure budget alerts to prevent cost overruns."

"Using Bubble.io, build no-code AI matching system with visual workflows. Create: (1) Database structure for students/opportunities with custom fields (province, transport, NSFAS status, etc.), (2) Multi-step profile form with conditional logic, (3) Matching workflow using Bubble AI Agent to calculate scores, (4) Results page with filtering/sorting, (5) Admin dashboard for monitoring matches. Integrate OpenAI API for match explanations. Use Bubble's responsive engine for mobile-first design. Implement data privacy settings for POPI compliance."

UI Design: "Design mobile-responsive pages using Bubble's visual editor. Create reusable components: profile progress bar, match card, filter panel. Use Bubble's built-in responsive settings for mobile/desktop layouts. Add loading states with Bubble's workflows. Style with mobile-first principles."

Backend Integration: "Set up Bubble database: Student (fields: name, skills list, province, transport option, NSFAS boolean), Opportunity (fields: company, location, stipend amount, requirements). Create backend workflow 'Calculate Match Score' using API Connector to OpenAI, storing results in Match table. Schedule recurring workflow to update matches daily."

Testing: "Use Bubble debugger to test workflows step-by-step. Create test data: 20 student profiles, 30 opportunities. Validate matching logic correctness, filter functionality, sorting. Test on real mobile devices via Bubble's preview URL. Check database query performance with large datasets."

Deployment: "Deploy to Bubble's cloud with custom domain. Configure SEO settings for discoverability. Set up privacy rules: students see only their matches, companies see aggregated data. Enable Bubble's built-in analytics. Configure email/SMS notifications via SendGrid plugin."

Optimization: "Optimize database searches with Bubble's indexing. Reduce API calls to OpenAI by caching common match explanations. Implement pagination for large result sets. Use Bubble's CDN for static assets. Monitor capacity units to prevent slow performance."

"Using Wix Studio, rapidly build AI matching interface leveraging Wix AI tools. Create: (1) Wix Forms for profile collection with conditional fields, (2) Wix Data Collections for students/opportunities, (3) Velo code for matching algorithm (JavaScript), (4) Dynamic pages showing match results, (5) Wix Bookings for interview scheduling. Use Wix AI Site Generator for initial layout, then customize for SA context. Integrate Wix CRM for applicant tracking. Ensure mobile-responsive with Wix's automatic layout adjustment."

UI Design: "Use Wix Studio's drag-drop editor to design profile form with step indicator. Add Wix Input elements for each field (dropdown for province, checkbox for transport options, toggle for NSFAS). Create repeater for displaying match cards. Apply mobile-responsive settings. Use Wix AI to generate color scheme matching SA flag colors."

Backend Integration: "Set up Wix Data Collections: Students (fields matching profile), Opportunities, Matches (linking students to opportunities with score). Write Velo code for matching algorithm in backend.jsw file. Use wix-data API for queries. Integrate OpenAI via HTTP Functions for generating match explanations."

Testing: "Use Wix Preview mode to test on different devices. Validate form submissions, data storage, matching calculations. Test with Wix's built-in testing tools. Check page load speeds with Wix's performance panel. Ensure GDPR/POPI consent banner works correctly."

Deployment: "Publish site to Wix servers with custom domain (internus.co.za). Enable Wix SEO Wiz for search optimization. Configure Wix Analytics to track user behavior. Set up Wix Automations for email notifications on new matches. Connect Wix Ascend for CRM features."

Optimization: "Optimize images with Wix's built-in compression. Minimize Velo code by removing unused functions. Use Wix's CDN for faster content delivery. Enable lazy loading for match cards. Configure caching headers for static assets."

"Using Webflow with AI App Gen, design professional matching interface with custom interactions. Build: (1) Webflow CMS for students/opportunities with custom fields, (2) Multi-step form with Webflow Forms + custom JavaScript, (3) Dynamic collection pages for match results, (4) Custom code for matching algorithm (JavaScript + external AI API), (5) Interactions/animations for engaging UX. Use Webflow's responsive design system for mobile-first approach. Integrate Memberstack for user authentication, Airtable/Make for automation workflows."

UI Design: "Design in Webflow Designer with component-based approach. Create profile form with step transitions (scroll-triggered animations). Design match card component with hover effects. Use Webflow's breakpoints for mobile/tablet/desktop. Apply Webflow AI to generate initial layouts, then refine for SA brand identity (colors, typography)."

Backend Integration: "Set up Webflow CMS Collections: Students, Opportunities. Use custom code embed to add JavaScript for matching logic. Integrate with external API (Supabase/Firebase) for real-time data. Use Webflow Logic for form submission handling. Connect Make (formerly Integromat) for workflow automation (e.g., trigger OpenAI API on new profile)."

Testing: "Test responsive design in Webflow's built-in preview. Use browser DevTools for mobile testing. Validate CMS content displays correctly. Test form submissions and custom code functionality. Check cross-browser compatibility (Chrome, Safari, Firefox). Validate performance with Lighthouse."

Deployment: "Publish to Webflow hosting with custom domain. Configure SSL certificate. Set up Webflow's built-in CDN for fast global delivery. Add SEO metadata for each page. Connect Google Analytics and Webflow's native analytics. Configure form notifications via email/webhooks."

Optimization: "Optimize images (convert to WebP) in Webflow's asset panel. Minimize custom code by removing unused scripts. Use Webflow's lazy loading feature. Configure asset loading strategy (preload critical CSS). Monitor with Webflow's Speed Insights, aim for <3s load time on SA 3G networks."
